name: toffoli_uncompute_measurement_elision
precondition: family = dv_recon (Toffoli-level IRCircuit, zero continuous Rz, measurement-free input); needs toffoli and hadamard; 3 <= qubits <= 20 so the whole-circuit judge still runs; the op list must contain at least two ccz/ccx ops sharing an unordered control pair; no extra qubits are requested (resource use is a mid-circuit measurement on an EXISTING wire, so ancilla_room is not required). The rule only ever edits the LATER member of a compute/uncompute pair; circuits with no such pair are declined before any rewrite and cost nothing.
identity: Recognise AND-scratch pairs and delete the uncomputation, keeping the computation untouched. Read every H-sandwiched CCZ as a Toffoli: h(t) ccz(a,b,t) h(t) == ccx(a,b -> t). Let G1 = ccx(a,b -> t) at position i and G2 = ccx(a,b -> t) at position j > i be two Toffolis with the SAME unordered control pair {a,b} and the SAME target t, such that (i) t is certified to be in |0> immediately before G1, (ii) no op strictly between i and j writes t (no x/cx/ccx/ccz-with-H targeting t, no h on t) -- t may be READ freely, i.e. appear as a control of cx/ccx/ccz or be acted on by diagonal gates, and (iii) no op strictly between i and j writes a or b (a, b may be read). Then t holds exactly a AND b on the whole span, and G2 is a pure uncomputation. REWRITE: delete G2 (together with its two sandwiching h(t) if it is encoded as h-ccz-h) and emit in its place the measurement-based uncompute, which `v4.api.dv` exposes natively as the 0-T gadget `and_uncompute(a, b, t)`: h(t); measure t -> m; classically controlled cz(a,b) on m = 1; the wire t is thereafter a fresh |0> scratch wire (it is NOT removed, so the qubit count is unchanged). The computing Toffoli G1 is left exactly as it is -- this rule does not re-synthesise it, does not introduce `and_compute`, and does not change any CCZ that is not the second half of such a pair. A maximal chain ccx(a,b->t) ... ccx(a,b->t) ... ccx(a,b->t) with the same {a,b},t is treated as consecutive pairs, the even-indexed members being uncomputations.
correctness: Under conditions (i)-(iii) a forward GF(2) argument gives the state of t on the span exactly: t = 0 before G1, G1 sets t ^= a*b, and nothing between i and j writes t, a or b, so just before G2 the register is in a superposition of basis states sum_x alpha_x |a(x), b(x), rest(x)> |t = a(x) AND b(x)>, i.e. t is a deterministic function of the surviving data and carries no independent amplitude. G2 would map t back to 0. The gadget does the same thing up to a Pauli correction: H on t followed by a computational-basis measurement is an X-basis measurement, whose outcome m in {0,1} is uniform and INDEPENDENT of x because <+|a&b> = <-|a&b>^(+-) has modulus 1/sqrt(2) for both values of a&b; the post-measurement data state is (-1)^{m*(a(x) AND b(x))} alpha_x |data(x)>, i.e. the residual operator is CZ(a,b)^m, which the classically controlled cz(a,b) undoes exactly. Hence each branch applies K_m = U_correct with c_m = 1/sqrt(2) -- the SAME constant for every input x, so invariant 2 (phase consistency) holds, and sum_m |c_m|^2 = 1/2 + 1/2 = 1. The wire t is left in a product state |0> or |1> that the gadget resets, so it re-enters the circuit as clean |0> scratch exactly as after G2: the branch-wise specification check the judge runs on measured constructions is satisfied with zero ledger charge, and the removed Toffoli's 7 T are replaced by Clifford + classical control only. The h-ccz-h == ccx reading is the exact CCX = H_t CCZ H_t identity over Z[omega]; a ccz whose target is not H-sandwiched is never matched. Certification of (i): forward symbolic ANF propagation (wire -> set of GF(2) monomials) from the circuit's declared initial state, with the input register left symbolic and scratch wires initialised to the constant 0; the wire must still carry the constant 0 at position i. If the analysis cannot prove t = 0, the match is not emitted -- no guessing, so a wrong ancilla guess can never be the reason for a rejection.
trigger: One forward pass. (1) Fold h(q) ccz(a,b,q) h(q) patterns, with no other op touching q in between, into virtual ccx(a,b -> q) entries, remembering the three original op indices. (2) Propagate per-wire ANF (frozenset of int bitmasks, constant 1 = empty mask) under x: p ^= 1, cx: p_b ^= p_a, ccx: p_t ^= p_a * p_b, cutting at any h that was not folded (such an h makes its wire's ANF unknown and poisons that wire until it is overwritten). (3) For each virtual ccx at position i with p_t == {} (the constant 0) just before it, scan forward for the next virtual ccx with the same unordered {a,b} and the same t; accept it as a match iff every op strictly between the two has t, a, b outside its TARGET set (controls are fine) and no unfolded h touches t, a or b in the span. (4) Emit one match per such pair: (i, j, a, b, t, the op indices to delete). Matches are emitted in circuit order, disjoint in j, and the pass is re-run after each accepted application so that a newly cleaned scratch wire can start a new pair. apply() splices out G2's ops and inserts `and_uncompute(a, b, t)`; the qubit count and every other op are unchanged.
expected_effect: modred_21's entire non-Clifford content is the 17 ccz (119 T = 17 x 7); the 30 h, 24 x and 3 cx are free. The 'h ccz h' trigram (11x) says most ccz are H-sandwiched Toffolis, and the fingerprint's 7 shared_control_pairs says control pairs are reused. Modular reduction against a constant computes a comparison out of AND terms on scratch wires, conditionally subtracts, and then UNCOMPUTES the comparison, so the circuit should contain a handful of exact compute/uncompute Toffoli pairs on the same control pair and target. Each pair that fires deletes one Toffoli = 7 T and adds only h, a measurement and one classically controlled cz. Conservatively 2 pairs survive the strict same-controls / no-intervening-write guard: 119 -> 105 T, with upside to 119 - 28 = 91 if 4 fire. Qubits stay at 11, CNOT count is unchanged (the classically controlled cz is not a two-qubit quantum gate on the critical cost order's CNOT tally only if priced as such; otherwise it adds at most one cz per fired pair), zero error drawn. Distinct from the prefiltered temporary-AND card: that one re-synthesised EVERY ccz into a 4-T and_compute (+1 ancilla, saving 3 T on all 17); this one adds no ancilla, leaves every computing Toffoli alone, and takes 7 T only where a Toffoli is provably redundant uncomputation.
source: C. Gidney, 'Halving the cost of quantum addition', Quantum 2, 74 (2018), arXiv:1709.06648 (measurement-based uncomputation of an AND: X-basis measurement plus a classically controlled CZ, 0 T); the recognition of uncomputation Toffolis on |0>-initialised scratch wires by GF(2)/ANF propagation is the standard reversible-logic pebbling argument (Bennett 1973; Soeken-Chattopadhyay DAC 2016), and the same elision is used throughout Gidney-Ekera, arXiv:1905.09749.
